Qasam hai fajr ke waqt ki.
Aur dus raaton ki
Aur jufft ki aur taaq ki.
Aur raat ki jab woh chal khri ho. (ke aakhirat mein jza o saza zaroor hogi)
Ek aqal wale (ko yaqeen dlane) ke liye yeh qasmen kafi hain ke nahin ?
Kiya tum ne dekha nahin ke tumhare Parwardigar ne aad ke saath kiya sulook kiya.
Us unche sutuno wali qaum erum ke saath
Jis ke barabar duniya ke mulkon mein koi aur qaum paida nahin ki gayi ?
Aur samood ki us qaum ke saath kya kya jis ne o adi mein pathar ki chtanon ko tarash rakhha tha ?
Aur mekhon wale Firaun ke saath kya kya ?
Yeh woh log the jinhon ne duniya ke mulkon mein sarkashi ikhtiyar karli thi.
Aur un mein bohat fasaad machaya tha.
Chunanche tumhare Parwardigar ne un par azab ka kora barsa diya.
Yaqeen rakho tumhara Parwardigar sab ko nazar mein rkhe hue hai.
Lekin insan ka haal yeh hai ke jab us ka Parwardigar use azmata hai aur inam o ikraam se nawazta hai to woh kehta hai ke : mere Parwardigar ne meri izzat ki hai.
Aur dusri taraf jab use azmata hai aur us ke rizq mein tangi kardyta hai to kehta hai ke : mere Parwardigar ne meri tohin ki hai.
Hargiz aisa nahin chahiye. Sirf yehi nahin bulke tum yateem ki izzat nahin karte.
Aur miskeeno ko khana khilane ki ek dusre ko targeeb nahin dete.
Aur miras ka maal sameit sameit kar kha jate ho.
Aur maal se behd mohabbat karte ho.
Hargiz aisa nahin chahiye. Jab zameen ko qoot qoot kar riza riza kardiya jaye ga.
Aur tumhara Parwardigar aur qatarein bandhe hue farishte (maidan hashar mein) aayein ge.
Aur us din jahannam ko samne laya jaye ga, to us din insan ko samajh aaye gi aur us waqt samajh aane ka mauqa kahan hoga ?
Woh kahe ga ke : kaash ! Mein ne apni us zindagi ke liye kuchh aage bhej diya hota.
Phir us din Allah ke barabar koi azab dene wala nahin hoga.
Aur na us ke jkrne ki tarah koi jkrne wala hoga.
(albatta nek logon se kaha jaye ga ke) ae woh jaan jo (Allah ki itaat mein) chain pachki hai.
Apne Parwardigar ki taraf us tarah lot kar aaja ke to us se razi ho, aur woh tujh se razi.
Aur shamil hoja mere (nek) bandon mein.
Aur dakhil hoja meri jannat mein.
